name: Proper score
rule: Cluster-robust lower bound of benchmark-relative Brier skill falls below zero over the live window.

name: Closing line value
rule: Mean CLV over the last 100 graded bets is negative, once prices exist.

name: Calibration drift
rule: Calibration slope leaves its 95% band on the live window.

name: Sample stall
rule: Fewer than 50 new graded bets in 8 weeks, so the estimate cannot be refreshed.

name: Data-source break
rule: A source a family depends on fails its drift alarm or disappears.

name: Rule drift
rule: The live rule differs from the registered rule text, for any reason.
